summary.intent: Act as lead/coordinator session for the Callisto v1 alpha work: launch and watch background sessions, track per-work-package status in the plan file, manage PR merge order and overlaps, and only interrupt the user for merge-ready PRs or credential needs.
summary.outcome: Coordinated sessions across WPs A-N, merged #560 (deny.toml advisory fix) and unblocked a chain of PRs (#561-#569, #596). Also ran a five-area dead-code audit (~1,350 lines removable) that spawned cleanup PRs (#599-#604), and launched a differential test against the real Changesets CLI. The release is waiting on #599 and then release PR #558; the full v1 alpha 'done when' has not been reached.

repo: A new RUSTSEC advisory (RUSTSEC-2026-0542, humantime unmaintained via dev-dep trycmd) failed the cargo-deny audit on every PR; the fix is an ignore in deny.toml, owned by WP A (#560), and the other PRs rebase after it merges.

Entire gates (trails, changes, findings) are part of PR readiness: a PR can show red only because of a missing reviewer approval or open findings. Findings are resolved with `entire trail finding resolve`, and PRs are linked to trails with `entire trail link`.
Launch rules forbid `Claude-Session:` trailers in commits and require signed commits and no stacked PRs (branch from main). The auto-mode classifier refused a push that carried the trailer.
cargo-mutants output (`mutants.out.old/`) was committed in two PRs; .gitignore only covered `mutants.out/` and was widened to `mutants.out*/`.
Plan says tokenless publishing (J, #569) must merge after publish isolation (L), and L must wait on #565 (D) because both edit the workflow templates and init.rs.

Dead-code audit pattern: when a PR replaces an API, the old public function stays alive via tests and docs keep pointing at it. Proposed an AGENTS.md rule that a replacing PR deletes the old API and moves its tests.
cargo-machete does not flag unused dev-deps or [workspace.dependencies] entries.
An empty PYPI_TOKEN is passed to twine while npm filters an empty NPM_TOKEN, which can block the tokenless PyPI fallback (fixed in #599).
Changesets matching uses micromatch (extglobs, negation); Callisto's own glob matcher differs. Co-located packages must be resolved by their npm-native identity, not the primary Cargo package ID.

code.finding: WP I (#563) conflicts with main here because #560 also edited this bench file, so it needs a manual merge rather than a plain rebase.

Inline copy of the 'publishes somewhere' predicate (also at :380-383 and :568-572 and in release_decision.rs). It duplicates callisto_model Package::is_release_point (package.rs:81); the plan is to keep is_release_point and delete the copies.
IdentityIndex::resolve_native has only test callers. Production uses resolve_native_with_fallback and native_in_ecosystem; it is slated for removal along with about 110 lines of tests.
build_python, pack_npm and package_cargo are the same handler written three times and can be folded into one.

friction: Sandbox blocked the session daemon socket, so `claude agents` had to be rerun outside the sandbox.
Session 2 stalled on a worktree permission prompt that only the user could answer; the lead eventually stopped it and resumed it inside the D worktree.
The first resume of Session 5 failed because of the short-id issue, which cost time before the fixes started.
Session 1's claimed push of the mutants cleanup never reached the remote because of a silent push failure.
Session 3 was blocked when the classifier refused its commit with a session trailer.
The user was frustrated when #563 (change #171) stayed red after the lead said PRs would go green, and again by the volume of findings on change #204 (#596).
Flaky tests appeared on full-workspace runs and pass on rerun: registry_version_the_registry_serves_is_exact_with_no_checksum_or_yank_claim and init::tests::an_existing_config_errors.
A git fetch timed out during the open-PR conflict check, so the first results were stale and had to be rerun.
`entire brain inspect dead-code` failed with 'search store not built for this commit', so the audits fell back to grep.
open_items: Merge order: #599 (PyPI empty-token fix), then release PR #558. #600-#604 cleanup PRs await CI and approval; #601 was still in CI.
#596 (K, Changesets migration) has open findings: restrict glob translation to provably equivalent patterns, use npm-native identity, and report baseBranch after final workflow result.
Differential test #602 against real Changesets CLI; the fixed-group step is added by hand until #596 lands.
Session 4 (Q, verify-real) is not yet launched; it waits on E and F2 merging. G, H, L, then #569 (J) are still pending behind F1/F2 and #565.
Decide whether E's (#561) changeset is Breaking; the lead recommends yes.
Decisions pending or deferred: the actions' moon install step, the persisted executor state's unused block reasons, and the empty-TWINE handling.
Add the AGENTS.md rule that a PR replacing an API deletes the old API and moves its tests.
Status table in the plan file must be kept updated; the full 'every WP merged and just verify-real passes' condition is not yet met.
